Voice typing's AI polish now follows your own instructions, and long dictations no longer come back unpolished.

**Tell the polish how you write** (#679)

- Settings › Voice typing › AI polish now has a box for your own instructions, such as "use a formal written tone", "keep English product names in English" or "use bullets for lists". The polish follows them within its usual rules, so it still never adds anything you didn't say or answers what you dictated.
- Long dictations get more time to polish. The wait was a flat 4 seconds, so a 300–800 character dictation often ran out of time and was pasted exactly as transcribed. Short dictations still get 4 seconds; longer ones get up to 10.
- On Parley Cloud, every AI feature now runs on the larger model (gpt-oss-120b), so polish, live suggestions and reports read better. Each request costs more of your AI credits than before.

**API keys for your own tools** (#678)

- Signed in to Parley Cloud, you can create and revoke personal API keys in Settings › Account › API keys. A key lets a server or script read your synced recordings without the app open. The secret is shown once, when you create it, and the list shows when each key was last used. The API reference is in `docs/api.md`.
